claims.value: Source-explicit SM/MSSM inheritance is expanded using the declared atlas baseline: three ordinary SM chiral families, no independent RH neutrino unless stated. Exact Dynkin and all-LH conversion are conventions/derivations, not newly printed source tables. Gauge connections and dependent conjugates are not extra matter.

locator.anchor: we gauge two copies of the SM

claims.value: Linear realization uses one complex global-SU4 H=(HA,HB), each a gauge doublet of its own sector. The complete unextended twin construction gauges two copies of SM and interchanges every ordinary particle with its twin. Expand each using the declared RSM baseline; global SU4 and SU6 are not extra gauge factors.

Extended top adds crossed-colour/weak exotic LH quarks and opposite-charge partners; Eq4 suppresses their hypercharges. Later nonlinear realization integrates out the radial mode; optional massive twin hypercharge has unspecified dynamical origin above cutoff. Do not union these with the linear unextended inventory.

source_descriptions.reason: Linear twin inventory is ready, not a certificate for nonlinear/mirror or extended-top regimes. Crossed exotic hypercharges and CP/chirality source map remain to be established explicitly.
